children: Chinese President Xi Jinping said that the country is making every effort to search for missing people following the mudslide disaster that occurred near the border crossing between Tibet and Nepal, Xinhua reported on Monday.
Xi, on a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, made his remarks at a meeting with his counterpart, President Sadyr Japarov, in Bishkek.
